g.text: YOUR AI DEMO WORKS.
PRODUCTION HAS FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS.
The agent gives a convincing answer. But did the database change?
Did the citation support the claim? Did the patch solve the
problem, or merely charm the test?
Measure Twice, Prompt Once shows product and engineering
teams how to turn those awkward questions into a working
evaluation loop.
INSIDE
Read real failures without drowning in traces
Build tasks and graders around evidence that matters
Compare changes without statistical theater
Connect CI, release gates, and production feedback
Give the loop an owner, a cadence, and a budget
Four published programs. One complete fictional loop. Plus
statistical recipes, thirteen exercises, sixteen templates, and a
30-day minimum viable eval-loop plan.
ABOUT THE AUTHOR
Brenn Hill is a software engineer, engineering leader,
and published author. He teaches AI-augmented development
practices and builds tools for verification, agent loops,
and human oversight.
looprails.com
